entities.name: Black Holes
entities.description: Black holes are one of the most fascinating and enigmatic phenomena in the universe. They are formed from the remnants of massive stars that have exhausted their nuclear fuel and undergone a supernova explosion. Black holes are characterized by their intense gravitational pull and the presence of a singularity at their center, surrounded by an event horizon.

attributes.Formation: From the remnants of massive stars that have exhausted their nuclear fuel and undergone a supernova explosion.
attributes.Singularity: A point of infinite density and zero volume at the center of the black hole.
attributes.Event Horizon: The point of no return beyond which nothing can escape the gravitational pull of the black hole.
attributes.Gravitational Pull: So strong that it warps spacetime itself.
attributes.Gravitational Time Dilation: A phenomenon where time slows down near a black hole relative to observers further away.
attributes.Schwarzschild Radius: The radius at which the escape velocity equals the speed of light.
attributes.Emission: Hawking radiation, a faint glow of radiation due to quantum effects near the event horizon.
attributes.Evaporation: Black holes slowly lose mass and eventually evaporate over time due to Hawking radiation.
attributes.Mystery: The nature of the singularity and the fate of information that falls into a black hole remain unresolved.
attributes.Testing Ground: For theories of gravity, such as general relativity, and for new ideas in quantum mechanics and string theory.
